title_en: AI-Era Resilience Extracurricular Program (Big Data Innovation Convergence University Project)
summary: The Big Data Innovation Convergence University Project Group announces a non-credit extracurricular program, "Algorithms and Choices: Do You Like This Post?", on building resilience in the AI era. Sessions are held on 26 November 2026 (19:00–21:00) and 27 November 2026 (14:00–16:00 and 17:00–19:00) at the Seoul National University Big Data HyFlex Learning Center, 7th floor, Angel Building, 203 Gwanak-ro. The notice does not state who may take part, whether participation is required, or how to register; these details may be in the attached poster, which was not read.
steps: Read the attached web poster (웹포스터_장소 수정본 (1).png). Its content was not read for this translation; it may contain eligibility and registration details that the notice text does not give.
Attend the session(s) at the Seoul National University Big Data HyFlex Learning Center, 7th floor, Angel Building, 203 Gwanak-ro (관악로 203 엔젤빌딩 7층), at the scheduled time.
translation:
[Big Data Innovation Convergence University Project Group] Notice of Extracurricular Program on Improving Resilience in the AI Era

A. Event title: Algorithms and Choices: Do You Like This Post?

B. Purpose: Experience-based extracurricular education that helps participants reflect on their own experiences and emotions amid the changes of the AI era and develop resilience.

C. Program schedule
- Session 1: Thursday 26 November 2026, 19:00–21:00
- Session 2: Friday 27 November 2026, 14:00–16:00
- Session 3: Friday 27 November 2026, 17:00–19:00

D. Venue: Seoul National University Big Data HyFlex Learning Center (7th floor, Angel Building, 203 Gwanak-ro)

Attachment (1 file): 웹포스터_장소 수정본 (1).png (web poster, revised venue; 253 KB). The content of this image was not read for this translation.
